title: Principal-parts resolution of a vector bundle on a regular curve
statement:
Let $k$ be a field and $X$ a nonempty integral Noetherian regular scheme of dimension one over $k$. Write $\eta$ for its generic point, $K=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ for its function field [def-sc-function-field], and $j:\{\eta\}\to X$. Let $E$ be a finite locally free $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf], meaning Zariski-locally a finite direct sum of copies of $\mathcal O_X$, and put $V=E_\eta$. For every closed point $x$, identify $E_x$ with its image in $V$ and let $i_x:\{x\}\to X$. There is a natural exact sequence of Zariski sheaves
$$0\longrightarrow E\longrightarrow j_*V\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{x\text{ closed}}i_{x,*}(V/E_x)\longrightarrow0.$$
Here $(j_*V)(U)=V$ for nonempty open $U$ and is zero for $U=\varnothing$; the last map sends a rational section to its germs modulo $E_x$. Both sheaves after $E$ are flasque, meaning that all restriction maps on opens are surjective. In particular, every $v\in V$ is in $E_x$ for almost every closed $x$, and the connecting map in cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] gives
$$H^0(X,E)=\bigcap_{x\text{ closed}}E_x\subset V,\qquad H^1(X,E)\cong\operatorname{coker}\!\left(V\longrightarrow\bigoplus_{x\text{ closed}}V/E_x\right).$$
These identifications are natural for morphisms of finite locally free modules. If $X$ is smooth over $k$ and $E=\Omega^1_{X/k}$ [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf], then $V=\Omega^1_{K/k}$ and $E_x$ is the image of $\Omega^1_{\mathcal O_{X,x}/k}$ in $\Omega^1_{K/k}$.

source.place: Tate, §3, pp. 156–157, exact sequence before Theorem 4, and §4, p. 157, divisor version; vector-bundle formulation of the same local construction. Blueprint proof: Cartier picture of divisors (the residue sequence).
